_description: Inkling 2 Mini — ThinkingMachines' small reasoning model, the inkling2 fleet family (two engine arms sharing the :8080 slot and the wire id: basalt 0.5.7 on the native NVFP4-MX8 pack via uap-basalt-inkling2-server, and squid5090 on the original HF checkpoint via uap-squid-inkling2-server). Family vision is DYNAMIC on the basalt arm and NONE at config level on the squid arm (the engine has no image parser at all — an image-bearing request would return HTTP 200 with hallucinated text over the silent drop, live-probed 2026-11-25), so the placement gate parks image traffic with carries_image and auto-switches arms within the family. Routes through the anthropic-proxy for the tool/finalize guardrails. Codex cannot reach this family: codex speaks the Responses API only and neither arm serves /v1/responses. Profile first created 2026-11-25 from LIVE MEASUREMENTS (probes via :4000 + the engine unit journal + the machine-local registry overlay, worktree 034) and re-measured the same day against the 0.5.7/MX8 uplift + the squid arm (worktree 035) — nothing here is transcribed from vendor docs.
_engine: Two arms, one wire id. BASALT ARM (uap-basalt-inkling2-server, engine 0.5.7 since the 2026-11-25 uplift from 0.5.5/q8): native pack Inkling-2-Mini-NVFP4-MX8.basalt (sha256 28ec7072…, KLD 0.00297/97.83% vs the retired q8 pack's 0.00305/97.76%), kv fp8, max-context 524288 since the 2026-11-26 vision posture (1048576 before — see _capacity_comment), vision dynamic, DSpark speculative decoding on by default with the pack (window 8, up to 7 drafts/pass). /props exposes n_ctx 262144 and total_slots 2 under the 2026-11-26 evening autotune posture (524288/1 under the morning vision posture, 1048576/1 when the 2026-11-25 numbers below were taken), model_alias 'Inkling 2 Mini'; /v1/models lists exactly that one id (the rails suite drift-checks this link, arm-gated). SQUID ARM (uap-squid-inkling2-server, squid5090 built at fda96e9d, Zig 0.17.1, pinned rev c9d02830 of thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini): fp8 weights/q4 KV, ctx 524288, DSpark drafter mtp.safetensors with --mtp 7 --spec-threshold 0.80, single-user c=1, text-only. Measured 2026-11-25: MX8 arm — health ok ~2s, loaded ~4s, decode 555-640 tok/s (DSpark acc 97%, TTFT 0.1s), 21K prompt read 15,397 tok/s, 64x64 image answers with seeing-the-image reasoning, resident 29050 MiB GPU / 16403 MiB RSS; squid arm — cold load ~2.5s, decode 322-605 tok/s across code/counting/chat, TTFT ~30ms, ~24.2 GiB VRAM, thinking-first SSE (reasoning_content deltas before content), native tool calls, resident 24194 MiB GPU / 554 MiB RSS. Both arms advertise exactly 'Inkling 2 Mini' at /v1/models — the squid arm was deliberately served under --model-name 'Inkling 2 Mini' to pin the family wire id, and the basalt arm VALIDATES the model field.
_model_comment: The family wire id both arms serve. basalt (llama-server class) validates the model field, so requests must carry exactly this id; squid does not validate but was pinned to the same id at serve time so a placement arm-switch is invisible to the client. The proxy's placement gate resolves the family by this id, and the profile rewrite puts this id on the wire for every profiled client. The rails suite drift-checks this field against the serving process (test/model-profiles-inkling2-rails.test.ts, arm-gated).
_max_tokens_comment: The measured natural cap of the answer-room machinery, NOT the qwen38 half-window rule. The two engines spend the completion budget differently and BOTH measurements agree 32768 is the honest value: the BASALT arm thinks SERVER-SIDE (answer-room auto derives the thinking budget from the requested max_tokens and clamps output; observed pairs budget/cap 6144/8192, 21000/28000, 24576/32768, 43008/57344 — requesting more than 32768 is accepted but the engine clamps, requesting starved values shrinks the thinking budget and degrades long-turn answers), while the SQUID arm streams thinking FIRST on the wire (reasoning_content deltas spend the completion budget before any content — the smoke's 512-token cap consumed the whole budget in reasoning and returned an empty content with finish=length, the same starvation class at the extreme). 32768 leaves reasoning + answer room on both arms and matches the proxy's tool-turn clamp for agentic turns. Do not change without re-measuring content compliance on BOTH arms.
_sampling_comment: The engine's own serve defaults (the squid unit flags --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95, carried by the basalt arm's config the same way) — the release's recommended sampling for this model, and the live flags both arms actually serve with: reading geometry from reality. This family has never been tool-call-tuned on this box (unlike qwen38's 0.3/0.9, which were measured against llama.cpp GSQ-RCO); re-tune with `uap tune` before deviating. No top_k/min_p/repetition_penalty pins: neither arm's live flags set them (034's round carried the qwen38 values as placeholders and this merge drops them), and the arms' speculative decoding (DSpark) has its own acceptance threshold (--spec-threshold 0.80 on squid) that interacts with tail truncation.
_stop_sequences_comment: DELIBERATELY EMPTY: every measured turn ended end=stop / finish=stop with no explicit markers on BOTH arms — these engines own their EOS handling (llama-family lineage under a custom looped-MoE chat template with an effort map; the squid engine streams its own thinking-then-EOS shape). The qwen38 profile's <|im_end|> marker is QWEN-template-specific and would never match here; carrying it would be transcribing, not measuring.
_context_window_comment: THIS IS A PER-SESSION CAP, AND IT IS OPT-IN BY PROFILE HEADER (same gap as qwen38: a client that sends no x-uap-model-profile header gets the whole pool — factory/droid custom models cannot send it, so their listings carry maxContextLimit client-side instead). The cap deliberately sits at or under the per-rail servable context: the 2-rail shared-context split (N x ctx/N KV) halves what one rail can serve, so under the 2026-11-26 evening posture (basalt pool 262144, 2 rails) the per-rail servable is 131072 and the cap follows it exactly (the rails suite enforces this invariant). History: 262144 under the morning 524288 single-rail pools (both arms left >= 2x headroom); 131072 under the evening 256k/2-rail autotune posture. A placement arm-switch mid-session must not invalidate the cap — squid still serves 524288 q4 single-rail, so 131072 keeps >= 4x headroom there. It also does NOT chase the proxy's auto-detected PROXY_CONTEXT_WINDOW (the startup script probes whichever arm is resident — 262144 on the evening basalt, 524288 on squid — so a profile pinned to that reading breaks on the first arm switch; the earlier 114688 reading was exactly that, a qwen-era detection). Admission defaults 4: four hot sessions at cap demand 524288 cells — 2x overcommit on the evening basalt 256k pool, exact-fit headroom elsewhere — contention degrades to queueing (idle sessions prune at the 90s TTL, waiters force-admit at 300s by evicting the LRU admission), the same operator-accepted arithmetic as qwen38.
_thinking_comment: Native thinking on both arms, surfaced differently per engine — the proxy must not assume one shape. The BASALT arm thinks SERVER-SIDE: the answer-room auto machinery runs the thinking budget inside the engine and the wire carries ONLY the answer (no reasoning_content field; answers arrive content+tool_calls with finish=stop, the budget visible only in the engine log — measured 2026-11-25 via :4000). The truncation class that forced PROXY_THINKING_BUDGET_FRACTION=0 on the qwen38 arm does not exist there. The SQUID arm streams thinking FIRST: reasoning_content deltas precede content on every turn (thinking-first SSE, measured direct on :8080), and a starved max_tokens empties the content while reasoning spends the budget — see _max_tokens_comment. The proxy probes the backend once and adapts (PROXY_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS=auto); thinking-disable knobs stay off for this family.

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: MEASURED 2026-11-25 (probe via :4000, basalt arm): this engine emits ONE tool call per turn by default (finish=tool_calls, single list_dir for a two-tool task) — the suffix flips it to parallel emission (both list_dir+read_file in one turn). Without this suffix the arm is sequential and agent loops pay one round-trip per tool. The squid arm answers native tool_calls (get_weather {city: Paris} finish=tool_calls in the smoke) with the same suffix applied.

concurrency._comment: One arm resident at a time (the arms conflict on :8080). The 2026-11-26 evening autotune posture configures the basalt arm with total_slots 2 (recorded in server_optimization.parallel_rails, drift-checked live at 18:51) and this field follows it — the rails suite enforces parallel-requests == rails. History: 1 under the single-slot postures (squid remains c=1 by engine design); the shared-context split (N x ctx/N KV) is the cost the 2-rail posture pays, and the session cap moved to 131072 with it (see _context_window_comment). PROXY_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT/UAP_MODEL_SLOTS follow this field. SESSION ADMISSION stays 4 (the durable operator default 2026-11-18).
concurrency._kv_shared_comment: One arm, one pool: a session addresses the WHOLE pool rather than owning a slice.

server_optimization._kv_dtype_comment: The basalt arm's KV class (kv fp8; pool below). The squid arm serves q4 KV over its 524288 ctx — the registry's per-config measurements carry each arm's exact posture; this field names the family default arm.
server_optimization._capacity_comment: 2026-11-26 POSTURE CHANGE (wave 6, item 4, operator-approved): the basalt arm's config dropped max-context 1048576 -> 524288 to enable WORKING VISION — at the 1M pool the engine loads at 31.7/32.6 GB leaving 0.9 GB free and the on-demand image encoder class (792 MiB) does not fit; at 524288 it loads at 24.8/32.6 GB with 7.8 GB free, the encoder measured 53 MiB on demand, and a live 64x64 image request answered CORRECTLY ('teal', 2026-11-25 + re-verified on the 2026-11-26 restart). 2026-11-26 EVENING POSTURE (operator's autotune stack, stable since ~15:07): the resident basalt-autotune serve moved the arm again — /props now exposes n_ctx 262144 and total_slots 2 (read live 18:51 by the rails drift-check, which caught the divergence). The 512k vision posture's encoder-fits arithmetic is not invalidated by the smaller pool (more free, not less), but vision was NOT re-probed at 256k — re-verify the live image path before relying on it under this posture. The squid arm's pool is unchanged (524288 q4).

speculative_decoding._comment: DSpark MTP drafting with the vendor's own drafter head (mtp.safetensors, 636 MB, sha256 7c3b6513…). squid arm: --mtp 7 --spec-threshold 0.80 (up to 7 drafts/pass, threshold-verified live). basalt arm: DSpark on by default with the MX8 pack, window 8, up to 7 drafts/pass (0.5.6 release notes). Both arms draft in-engine — no external draft artifact to pin beyond the checkpoint file the registry records. Output is the model's own (verified drafting, both arms).

server_optimization._comment: The flags the serve units actually run with. squid: --mode fp8 --kv q4 --ctx 524288 --mtp 7 --spec-threshold 0.80 --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95, LD_LIBRARY_PATH cuda-13.4 lib64, graphs on, prefix cache on. basalt: config basalt-inkling2-mx8.json (gpu 0, kv fp8, max-context 524288 since the 2026-11-26 vision posture, vision dynamic, port 8080), unit Env carries the cuda-libs redist path.

measured._arm_comment: 2026-11-25, measured LIVE — the 034 round probed the q8-era arm via the proxy (:4000) and the engine journal; the 035 round re-measured after the 0.5.7/MX8 uplift (decode/TTFT/acceptance below are the MX8 numbers, supersedes the q8-era 294-375 tok/s at TTFT 0.5s) and smoked the squid arm direct (322-605 tok/s code/counting/chat, TTFT ~30ms, cold 18.9K prefill 16,855 tok/s HTTP, exact-echo + native tool call verified). Tool-call geometry (basalt, still the engine's behavior on MX8): tool_choice=required honored (finish=tool_calls); sequential emission by default; batching-suffix-inducible parallel emission (both tools in one turn). Thinking: server-side answer-room on basalt (no reasoning field on the wire; budgets 6144-43008 observed adapting to the request), thinking-first reasoning_content on squid. Footprints (cgroup-measured 2026-11-25, both arms live): basalt MX8 29050 MiB GPU / 16403 MiB RSS idle with the FULL 1,048,576-cell fp8 pool resident (2026-11-25, the 1M posture those numbers were taken under; the 2026-11-26 524288 posture measured 24986 MiB GPU on load, live-verified after the restart); squid fp8 24194 MiB GPU / 554 MiB RSS (zero-Python single binary, weights mmap'd). Cache: prefix reuse 24% overall / 76% miss (~6,076 tok re-read per turn, q8-era journal numbers — the same conversation-cache machinery serves MX8; re-read the journal before re-pinning).
measured._decode_comment: MX8 arm measured range 555-640 tok/s at ~21k-token prompts (the uplift's routed-experts win; the q8 arm measured 294-375). The squid arm measured 322-605 tok/s — the family range spans both engines.
measured.speculative_acceptance: 0.97 (MX8 21K probe; q8-era DSpark per-turn range 0.64-0.98 from the engine log)

sustained_load._comment: Wave 6, item 6 — the idle-probe numbers above describe a COLD single request; these are the same arm UNDER REAL WORKLOAD, engine journal, 2026-11-25/26 (round-5's seventh launch, ~9.5h client session with 71k-84k-token prefills, then the 5h21m 90-mission power benchmark on the same arm). Decode holds 261-263 tok/s sustained at 71k+ prompts (vs 555-640 idle-probe — the routed-experts win halves under long-context load); prefill 2,378-8,291 tok/s at 71k-84k tokens (the 10:04 request: pp=84370/0c 10.2s 8291t/s, tg=155 261.2t/s acc=66%); DSpark acceptance 66-82% under load (vs 0.97 on the 21k idle probe); TTFT 0.5s at 71k prompts; prefix cache 99.9% WITHIN a session's turns (the 0.24 above is cross-session reuse — different measures, both honest). Concurrency note: this is single-slot decode with the SwiftShader render loop sharing the host during round-5 — the arm never stalled under the combined load.

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy, NOT the engine port directly — the proxy applies the tool/finalize guardrails and, via this profile, the per-session context window that clients size their history to. Clients select this profile with the header 'x-uap-model-profile: inkling2' (or a uap_model_profile body param); the profile map resolves the wire id 'Inkling 2 Mini' here for clients that cannot send the header.

_vision_comment: Family vision is dynamic (the basalt arm encodes with the engine's own encoder — 0 VRAM at rest, borrows expert-cache slots per image; the squid arm declares config-level vision none in the registry). Image-bearing requests through the proxy carry carries_image: the placement gate parks them on a text-only resident with reason vision_text_only_arm and auto-switches to the image-capable arm — the client's retry forwards with the image intact. Text requests are never parked for an image switch (the model:vision burst-key split). History: the q8-era arm parked image trips with a 409 because the on-demand encoder (~792 MiB) could not fit the ~450 MiB free at steady state — the MX8 uplift left ~3.5 GiB free at idle (measured 2026-11-25), retiring that OOM class; the basalt arm is the family's vision target now, and a live 64x64 probe answered with seeing-the-image reasoning.
